# National Association of REALTORS® Highlights Cavco’s Chassis-Free Manufactured Home


Published On: October 16, 2026


•


1 min read


•


The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) recently featured Cavco’s groundbreaking Grande Arbor frameless manufactured home prototype in an article examining how new federal legislation could expand affordable housing options across the country.


The[article, published Oct. 12 in REALTOR® News](https://www.nar.realtor/news/real-estate-news/the-next-generation-of-manufactured-homes-is-here) , highlights Cavco’s unveiling of the Grande Arbor at the 2026 Innovative Housing Showcase in Washington, D.C. The home is the first HUD-code manufactured home built without a permanent steel chassis, made possible by the recently enacted 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act.


The article also explores how the legislation could reshape manufactured housing by removing regulatory barriers, expanding financing options and encouraging zoning reforms. While the Grande Arbor demonstrates what’s possible, additional federal regulations and state approvals are needed before chassis-free manufactured homes can enter wider production and sale.


**The original article includes a video interview with Colleen Rogers, Cavco’s Senior Vice President of Marketing and Communications** , who discusses the Grande Arbor and what these changes could mean for the future of manufactured housing.


[Read the full article and watch the interview at REALTOR® News.](https://www.nar.realtor/news/real-estate-news/the-next-generation-of-manufactured-homes-is-here)


The Grande Arbor on the National Mall.
